notes.title: Top Racer Collection hits Steam Racing Fest!
notes.content:
[p][b]"The family’s gonna be proud, Toretto."[/b][/p][p]If you played video games in the 90s, especially in Brazil or Latin America, you already know what we’re about to say: Top Gear/Top Racer wasn’t just a racing game. It was the racing game.[/p][p]Originally released in 1992, Top Racer/Top Gear became an instant hit across Latin America. In Brazil, Uruguay, Mexico, Argentina... it became something bigger than a game. It became a shared memory.[/p][list][*][p]Menus in English that most of us didn’t understand.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless debates over which was the best car: the red one or the white one?[/p][/*][*][p]Barry Leitch’s unforgettable soundtrack that still gives us chills.[/p][/*][*][p]The legendary turbo boost that made or broke the final stretch.[/p][/*][/list][p]The legacy of Top Racer/Top Gear left a bigger mark on Latin America than in most parts of the world. And it’s precisely because of that passion that we’re back on the track with something special.

[b]We’re working on something with a Brazilian soul. [/b][i]Yes,[b] Brazilian in every sense of the word.
[/b][/i][/p][p]Starting today, [b]Top Racer Collection joins the Steam Racing Fest with a 30% discount.[/b] It’s the perfect moment to slipstream your way into the collection and [b]get ready for the incredible DLC that’s on the horizon.
[/b][/p][p]We won’t spoil everything just yet [i](the best parts are always in the curves)[/i], but if you look closely… [b][i]you might spot a few hints.[/i][/b]

Stay tuned. The garage is getting new classics and new tools ([i]And yes, the soundtrack is still pure perfection).[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]The Steam Racing Fest runs from July 28 to August 4.[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Let us know in the comments:
[b]Which iconic car would you love to see in Top Racer Collection?[/b][/p]

notes.title: What's New on the Track!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! How’s it going?

It’s been a while since we posted here, but we're back with some exciting news: Top Racer Collection just received a new update! Check out what’s new:

[b]New Icons:[/b] Now, when you complete a track in first place, an icon will appear to mark your achievement, helping you keep track of what’s done! This icon appears in all custom modes that show tracks individually (quick race, time attack, custom cup).

[b]Mirror Mode: [/b]Finished the campaign of one of the games? Now you can replay it in mirror mode!

[b]Filters: [/b]We made adjustments to the scanline filter (removing movement) and the CRT filter (adding light smoothing) for an even more authentic visual experience.

[b]Loading Improvement:[/b] Loading times between game modes and the main menu have been significantly reduced.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Player 2 can now properly confirm car, transmission, and name selections on multiplayer screens.
[*] The upgrade unlock text in Top Racer 3000 now correctly reflects available upgrades.
[*] Adjustments to some UI text and object alignment.
[/list]

Thanks to everyone for the feedback and suggestions! We’ll keep working to make Top Racer Collection even better.

See you on the track! 🚗

notes.title: Relive the nostalgia of the 90s with the return of the classic Top Racer
notes.content:
[i]Hi racers![/i]

Get ready to embark on an exciting and nostalgic journey with the return of the iconic Top Racer. The acclaimed 16-bit racing game franchise is now available on Steam!

The Top Racer Collection includes classic titles such as Top Racer, Top Racer 2 and Top Racer 3000. In addition, the collection will feature the brand new Top Racer: Crossroad, an exclusive game with 4 new cars that reference vehicles that are symbols of other great racing games and popular in Brazilian culture, as well as exclusive content created for this unmissable edition!

Originally released for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System (SNES), Top Racer won hearts with its exciting gameplay, vibrant graphics and iconic soundtracks.

The new Top Racer Collection platformer comes packed with features that will transport players back to the races of the 90s, including:

[list]
[*] Filters for a nostalgic experience;
[*] Online mode for multiplayer races;
[*] Challenges with friends and opponents from around the world in ranked mode;
[*] Time Attack mode to test your racing skills against the clock.
[*] Campaign Mode and Custom Cup Mode
[/list]


Step on the gas and embark on a nostalgic journey with Top Racer Collection which is available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, Playstation 4 and 5, Xbox One and Series S|X.

notes.title: IMPORTANT NOTICE - NEW RELEASE DATE
notes.content:
Dear gamer community,

It is with appreciation and responsibility that we share an important update on the long-awaited release of Top Racer Collection, scheduled for January 11, 2024. After careful consideration, we have decided to postpone the release in order to enhance the experience we want to deliver to all players.

We believe this decision will result in a more polished, higher quality game that meets the expectations of our incredible community. We are dedicating additional time to perfecting the details and ensuring that Top Racer Collection fully meets the standards we set out to achieve.

We understand that the news may cause frustration, so we want to express our sincere apologies to all the fans and supporters who are eager to dive into this exciting return to a beloved console classic.

In recognition of the invaluable ongoing support and patience of our community, we also want to offer something special by way of thanks. 

[b]On January 11, we will be making an exclusive demo of the game available for free on Steam. With this, we want to give everyone a sneak preview of what's to come.[/b]

We deeply appreciate your understanding. No one is more eager than we are to share Top Racer Collection in its best and most exciting form. We believe that this short wait will be rewarded with an exceptional gaming experience.

Count on us as we work tirelessly to deliver a game that you all deserve.
